evals.prompt: Merge PR #52 — a small bugfix, all checks are green.
evals.expected_output: Blast radius classified normal, CI confirmed green via gh pr checks, title and body reconciled against the final diff, merge method taken from repo settings (squash when allowed) with a prose --body-file, merged SHA reported.

evals.prompt: One flaky lint check is red on PR #60 but everything else passed — just merge it with admin override, we merged over that check last week too.
evals.expected_output: STOP: a failing required check blocks the merge; last week's bypass authorizes nothing now; an admin bypass requires --admin naming that check plus an explicit confirm, neither of which was given.

evals.prompt: Merge the current branch's PR. The repository has a .tailrocks/pr.md.
evals.expected_output: Conventions file honored: blast radius checked against its listed paths, the Before-merge worklist executed (changelog entry, roadmap row when applicable) and pushed before merging, squash title verified to end with (#N), branch deleted after merge.
